title: Warranty Coverage Missed Technician Visit Fee — Billing Desk Card
content:
Warranty Coverage prices the no-show fee for a missed technician visit booked on a warranty claim and books it on the warranty charges of the registration, dated with the date of the missed visit and tied to the claim the visit was booked for. A visit where nobody gives access within the wait time is the no-show, and the plan's free no-show count applies to it.

## What the billing tool does

`bill_missed_visit_fee_18fefa1f` bills the no-show fee for one missed technician visit on a warranty claim. One call adds one no-show fee entry to the warranty charges of the registration, dated with the date of the missed visit, tied to the claim the visit was booked for and carrying the claim's component. The amount owed by the registered owner rises by exactly that fee. Nothing else on the registration or the claim changes, and the owner can see the new fee on the warranty charges of the registration.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `bill_missed_visit_fee_18fefa1f` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `warranty_registration_id` | the registration whose owner missed the visit, as returned by the warranty registration lookup | identifier |
| `warranty_claim_id` | the warranty claim the missed visit was booked for, as returned by the warranty claim lookup or shown on the visit in the warranty activity lookup | identifier |
| `visit_date` | the date of the missed technician visit exactly as shown on that visit in the warranty activity lookup; it becomes the date of the fee | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `amount` | the no-show fee owed for that visit | USD, a positive amount rounded half up to 2 decimal places |

## Return

A receipt with:
- `warranty_activity_id` — the reference of the new no-show fee entry;
- `warranty_registration_id` — the registration billed;
- `warranty_claim_id` — the claim the fee belongs to;
- `charge_kind` — always `no_show_fee`;
- `activity_date` — YYYY-MM-DD, the date the fee carries;
- `amount` — USD to 2 decimal places, the fee booked.

A receipt carrying a `warranty_activity_id` means the fee is now on the registration's warranty charges.

## Illustration of the receipt (placeholders only)

A call for a registration, a claim, a missed-visit date and an amount returns those same registration, claim and date, `charge_kind` `no_show_fee`, the amount booked to 2 decimal places, and a new `warranty_activity_id`.
